newsitem.title: USA: Canadian dlr should rise on fundamentals--Thiessen.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dlr should rise on fundamentals--Thiessen.

text.p: The expectation of a stronger domestic economy is likely to boost the Canadian dollar, the head of the Bank of Canada said Saturday.
"The view that we've taken at the bank is that the fundamentals suggest a Canadian dollar that is likely to rise," Gordon Thiessen, governor of the Bank of Canada, told reporters.
He said lower interest rates point to a pickup in the economy, though effects of the drop in rates will, of course, take time to work their way through the economy.
"All signs are pointing to improvement," Thiessen said.
He added that Canada's improved fiscal position will also help the underlying fundamentals.
